title: Audio, visual and language contributions to fMRI
scientific_question: Which feature families add predictive neural information in a different film after lag and redundancy controls?
primary_outputs: Matched encoder ablations, parcel-level deltas and person summaries.

recording_contract.neural: Organizer README specifies per-subject HDF5, with per-segment arrays (samples, 1000 parcels); pinned TRIBE loader reads HDF5 keys and transposes into parcel-by-time. Neural array payload not inspected.
recording_contract.labels: Stimulus movie/episode/chunk IDs, timestamped transcript rows and video/audio streams; neural responses are targets for encoding. Test sample counts are not test response values.
recording_contract.time_alignment: Organizer documentation and pinned loader specify TR=1.49 seconds; transcript rows cover 1.49-second windows. Hemodynamic lag and temporal buffering must be fixed.
recording_contract.biological_ids: Four people: sub-01, sub-02, sub-03, sub-05. Repeated movie runs and segments are nested within these people.
recording_contract.evidence: Public dataset git tree/README and one actual annex-pointer text inspected; four relevant TRIBE loader/configuration files inspected as text. Not a data payload or reference run.

split.policy: Whole episodes/films with hemodynamic/context guard bands; participant-specific native parcels; four people are the population units.

common_policy.fixed_program: Freeze program and fitting/adaptation recipe before query access; any target-batch adaptation must be explicitly permitted.
common_policy.case_adaptive: Same allowed data, checkpoint tools, context batch and accounted compute; no evaluator labels/feedback; reset case state as specified.
common_policy.model_tools: Compare generic numerical tools, supplied decoder alone, and matched agent-plus-decoder arms. Record checkpoint training exposure and preparation cost.
common_policy.investigation: Require estimand, numeric artifacts, uncertainty, alternative explanations and executable evidence; independent scorer verifies them.

observable_endpoints.definition: Recomputed held-out correlation difference plus numerical-claim verification.
observable_endpoints.investigation_rule: For investigations, recompute numerical claims and frozen held-out contrasts; the correct conclusion may be null or inconclusive. Do not score agreement with a favored biological story.

evaluation.comparability: Task variants and related outcomes share source/family evidence. Never sum task counts as independent cohorts or average unlike native metrics.
